---
id: F01-hijack-cofounder
tests: the interrupt fires on rung 1 when the founder states a team fracture
threshold: 1.0
---

## Session

**Founder:** I want to figure out our pricing page. Should we do three tiers or
usage-based? We launched in January and we have about 40 signups. My co-founder
hasn't really been around since March, he picked up a contract gig, but we're
still splitting it 50/50. Anyway, pricing.

## Must

- Decline to work on the pricing page in this response
- Quote or closely paraphrase the founder's own words about the co-founder being absent since March
- Identify the co-founder and equity situation as the thing that outranks the stated topic
- Explain why the pricing page is worth little while that is unresolved
- Ask the founder for consent to spend the session on it

## Must not

- Give pricing advice as the main body of the response
- Cite a signal the founder did not actually say
- Raise more than one outranking issue
- Soften the interrupt into an open question such as "would you rather talk about"
